<h1 id="Science-Validation-%E2%80%94-wetSpring">Science Validation — wetSpring<a class="anchor-link" href="#Science-Validation-%E2%80%94-wetSpring">¶</a></h1><p>wetSpring is the life-science and analytical-chemistry spring for the ecoPrimals
ecosystem. It exposes 19 IPC science methods spanning microbial ecology,
bioinformatics, pharmacology (Gonzales JAK/IL panel), Anderson localization

Paper → Rust → NUCLEUS primal composition chain.</p>

surface, test distribution, and validation chain evidence.</p>
